guideline: Each criteria was rated on a scale from 1 (not at all) to 5 (very).

overall_notes: The extraction was reasonably accurate. The paper focuses on sarcasm generation using a retrieve-and-edit framework with commonsense knowledge. Human evaluation was conducted via Amazon Mechanical Turk with clear evaluation criteria. BLEU was mentioned but not heavily relied upon due to the creative nature of the task.
